/**
 * Cryptographic & Password Management Utilities
 *
 * Provides enterprise-grade, OWASP-aligned password hashing and verification
 * powered by `xypriss-security` and the Argon2id memory-hard algorithm.
 *
 * Key Security Features:
 * - **Argon2id Hybrid Algorithm**: Defends against GPU/ASIC brute-force cracking
 *   via enforced memory consumption (64 MB per hash) and resists side-channel attacks.
 * - **Pepper Defense Layer**: Integrates server-level secrets via `PASSWORD_PEPPER`
 *   to mitigate database leak vulnerabilities.
 * - **Constant-Time Verification**: Prevents timing attacks during credential validation.
 *
 * @see https://xypriss.nehonix.com/docs/security/password-manager
 */

import { PasswordManager } from "xypriss-security";

/**
 * Global PasswordManager instance configured with production-grade Argon2id parameters.
 *
 * Tuning Parameters:
 * - `memoryCost`: 65536 KB (64 MB of RAM per hash to defeat GPU/ASIC attacks)
 * - `parallelism`: 4 execution lanes
 * - `iterations`: 2 computational passes
 * - `pepper`: Optional server-side secret injected from `PASSWORD_PEPPER`
 * - `strength`: Minimum 12 characters with built-in dictionary attack prevention
 */
export const pwd = new PasswordManager({
  algorithm: "argon2id",
  memoryCost: 65536, // 64 MB of RAM
  parallelism: 4,    // 4 threads
  iterations: 2,     // 2 passes
  pepper: __sys__.__env__.get("PASSWORD_PEPPER"),
  strength: {
    minLength: 12,
    checkDictionary: true,
  },
});

/**
 * Cryptographic & Password Management Utilities
 *
 * Provides enterprise-grade, OWASP-aligned password hashing and verification
 * powered by `xypriss-security` and the Argon2id memory-hard algorithm.
 *
 * Key Security Features:
 * - **Argon2id Hybrid Algorithm**: Defends against GPU/ASIC brute-force cracking
 *   via enforced memory consumption (32 MB per hash) and resists side-channel attacks.
 * - **Pepper Defense Layer**: Integrates server-level secrets via `PASSWORD_PEPPER`
 *   to mitigate database leak vulnerabilities.
 * - **Constant-Time Verification**: Prevents timing attacks during credential validation.
 *
 * @see https://xypriss.nehonix.com/docs/security/password-manager
 */

import { PasswordManager } from "xypriss-security";

/**
 * Global PasswordManager instance configured with production-grade Argon2id parameters.
 *
 * Tuning Parameters:
 * - `memoryCost`: 32768 KB (32 MB of RAM per hash to defeat GPU/ASIC attacks)
 * - `parallelism`: 4 execution lanes
 * - `iterations`: 4 computational passes
 * - `pepper`: Optional server-side secret injected from `PASSWORD_PEPPER`
 * - `strength`: Minimum 12 characters with built-in dictionary attack prevention
 */
export const pwd = new PasswordManager({
  algorithm: "argon2id",
  memoryCost: 32768, // 32 MB of RAM
  parallelism: 4,    // 4 threads
  iterations: 4,     // 4 passes
  pepper: __sys__.__env__.get("PASSWORD_PEPPER"),
  strength: {
    minLength: 12,
    checkDictionary: true,
  },
});

/**
 * Cryptographic & Password Management Utilities
 *
 * Provides enterprise-grade, OWASP-aligned password hashing and verification
 * powered by `xypriss-security` and the Argon2id memory-hard algorithm.
 *
 * Key Security Features:
 * - **Argon2id Hybrid Algorithm**: Defends against GPU/ASIC brute-force cracking
 *   via enforced memory consumption (32 MB per hash) and resists side-channel attacks.
 * - **Pepper Defense Layer**: Integrates server-level secrets via `PASSWORD_PEPPER`
 *   to mitigate database leak vulnerabilities.
 * - **Constant-Time Verification**: Prevents timing attacks during credential validation.
 *
 * @see https://xypriss.nehonix.com/docs/security/password-manager
 */

import { PasswordManager } from "xypriss-security";

/**
 * Global PasswordManager instance configured with production-grade Argon2id parameters.
 *
 * Tuning Parameters:
 * - `memoryCost`: 32768 KB (32 MB of RAM per hash to defeat GPU/ASIC attacks)
 * - `parallelism`: 4 execution lanes
 * - `iterations`: 2 computational passes
 * - `pepper`: Optional server-side secret injected from `PASSWORD_PEPPER`
 * - `strength`: Minimum 12 characters with built-in dictionary attack prevention
 */
export const pwd = new PasswordManager({
  algorithm: "argon2id",
  memoryCost: 32768, // 32 MB of RAM
  parallelism: 4,    // 4 threads
  iterations: 2,     // 2 passes
  pepper: __sys__.__env__.get("PASSWORD_PEPPER"),
  strength: {
    minLength: 12,
    checkDictionary: true,
  },
});

 * Provides enterprise-grade, OWASP-aligned password hashing and verification
 * powered by `xypriss-security` and the Argon2id memory-hard algorithm.
 *
 * Key Security Features:
 * - **Argon2id Hybrid Algorithm**: Defends against GPU/ASIC brute-force cracking
 *   via enforced memory consumption (128 MB per hash) and resists side-channel attacks.
 * - **Pepper Defense Layer**: Integrates server-level secrets via `PASSWORD_PEPPER`
 *   to mitigate database leak vulnerabilities.
 * - **Constant-Time Verification**: Prevents timing attacks during credential validation.
 *
 * @see https://xypriss.nehonix.com/docs/security/password-manager
 */

import { PasswordManager } from "xypriss-security";

/**
 * Global PasswordManager instance configured with production-grade Argon2id parameters.
 *
 * Tuning Parameters:
 * - `memoryCost`: 131072 KB (128 MB of RAM per hash to defeat GPU/ASIC attacks)
 * - `parallelism`: 8 execution lanes
 * - `iterations`: 2 computational passes
 * - `pepper`: Optional server-side secret injected from `PASSWORD_PEPPER`
 * - `strength`: Minimum 12 characters with built-in dictionary attack prevention
 */
export const pwd = new PasswordManager({
  algorithm: "argon2id",
  memoryCost: 131072, // 128 MB of RAM
  parallelism: 8,    // 8 threads
  iterations: 2,     // 2 passes
  pepper: __sys__.__env__.get("PASSWORD_PEPPER"),
  strength: {
    minLength: 12,
    checkDictionary: true,
  },
});

/**
 * Cryptographic & Password Management Utilities
 *
 * Provides enterprise-grade, OWASP-aligned password hashing and verification
 * powered by `xypriss-security` and the Argon2id memory-hard algorithm.
 *
 * Key Security Features:
 * - **Argon2id Hybrid Algorithm**: Defends against GPU/ASIC brute-force cracking
 *   via enforced memory consumption (32 MB per hash) and resists side-channel attacks.
 * - **Pepper Defense Layer**: Integrates server-level secrets via `PASSWORD_PEPPER`
 *   to mitigate database leak vulnerabilities.
 * - **Constant-Time Verification**: Prevents timing attacks during credential validation.
 *
 * @see https://xypriss.nehonix.com/docs/security/password-manager
 */

import { PasswordManager } from "xypriss-security";

/**
 * Global PasswordManager instance configured with production-grade Argon2id parameters.
 *
 * Tuning Parameters:
 * - `memoryCost`: 32768 KB (32 MB of RAM per hash to defeat GPU/ASIC attacks)
 * - `parallelism`: 4 execution lanes
 * - `iterations`: 3 computational passes
 * - `pepper`: Optional server-side secret injected from `PASSWORD_PEPPER`
 * - `strength`: Minimum 12 characters with built-in dictionary attack prevention
 */
export const pwd = new PasswordManager({
  algorithm: "argon2id",
  memoryCost: 32768, // 32 MB of RAM
  parallelism: 4,    // 4 threads
  iterations: 3,     // 3 passes
  pepper: __sys__.__env__.get("PASSWORD_PEPPER"),
  strength: {
    minLength: 12,
    checkDictionary: true,
  },
});

/**
 * Cryptographic & Password Management Utilities
 *
 * Provides enterprise-grade, OWASP-aligned password hashing and verification
 * powered by `xypriss-security` and the Argon2id memory-hard algorithm.
 *
 * Key Security Features:
 * - **Argon2id Hybrid Algorithm**: Defends against GPU/ASIC brute-force cracking
 *   via enforced memory consumption (64 MB per hash) and resists side-channel attacks.
 * - **Pepper Defense Layer**: Integrates server-level secrets via `PASSWORD_PEPPER`
 *   to mitigate database leak vulnerabilities.
 * - **Constant-Time Verification**: Prevents timing attacks during credential validation.
 *
 * @see https://xypriss.nehonix.com/docs/security/password-manager
 */

import { PasswordManager } from "xypriss-security";

/**
 * Global PasswordManager instance configured with production-grade Argon2id parameters.
 *
 * Tuning Parameters:
 * - `memoryCost`: 65536 KB (64 MB of RAM per hash to defeat GPU/ASIC attacks)
 * - `parallelism`: 4 execution lanes
 * - `iterations`: 3 computational passes
 * - `pepper`: Optional server-side secret injected from `PASSWORD_PEPPER`
 * - `strength`: Minimum 8 characters with built-in dictionary attack prevention
 */
export const pwd = new PasswordManager({
  algorithm: "argon2id",
  memoryCost: 65536, // 64 MB of RAM
  parallelism: 4,    // 4 threads
  iterations: 3,     // 3 passes
  pepper: __sys__.__env__.get("PASSWORD_PEPPER"),
  strength: {
    minLength: 8,
    checkDictionary: true,
  },
});

/**
 * Cryptographic & Password Management Utilities
 *
 * Provides enterprise-grade, OWASP-aligned password hashing and verification
 * powered by `xypriss-security` and the Argon2id memory-hard algorithm.
 *
 * Key Security Features:
 * - **Argon2id Hybrid Algorithm**: Defends against GPU/ASIC brute-force cracking
 *   via enforced memory consumption (64 MB per hash) and resists side-channel attacks.
 * - **Pepper Defense Layer**: Integrates server-level secrets via `PASSWORD_PEPPER`
 *   to mitigate database leak vulnerabilities.
 * - **Constant-Time Verification**: Prevents timing attacks during credential validation.
 *
 * @see https://xypriss.nehonix.com/docs/security/password-manager
 */

import { PasswordManager } from "xypriss-security";

/**
 * Global PasswordManager instance configured with production-grade Argon2id parameters.
 *
 * Tuning Parameters:
 * - `memoryCost`: 65536 KB (64 MB of RAM per hash to defeat GPU/ASIC attacks)
 * - `parallelism`: 8 execution lanes
 * - `iterations`: 2 computational passes
 * - `pepper`: Optional server-side secret injected from `PASSWORD_PEPPER`
 * - `strength`: Minimum 16 characters with built-in dictionary attack prevention
 */
export const pwd = new PasswordManager({
  algorithm: "argon2id",
  memoryCost: 65536, // 64 MB of RAM
  parallelism: 8,    // 8 threads
  iterations: 2,     // 2 passes
  pepper: __sys__.__env__.get("PASSWORD_PEPPER"),
  strength: {
    minLength: 16,
    checkDictionary: true,
  },
});

 * Provides enterprise-grade, OWASP-aligned password hashing and verification
 * powered by `xypriss-security` and the Argon2id memory-hard algorithm.
 *
 * Key Security Features:
 * - **Argon2id Hybrid Algorithm**: Defends against GPU/ASIC brute-force cracking
 *   via enforced memory consumption (128 MB per hash) and resists side-channel attacks.
 * - **Pepper Defense Layer**: Integrates server-level secrets via `PASSWORD_PEPPER`
 *   to mitigate database leak vulnerabilities.
 * - **Constant-Time Verification**: Prevents timing attacks during credential validation.
 *
 * @see https://xypriss.nehonix.com/docs/security/password-manager
 */

import { PasswordManager } from "xypriss-security";

/**
 * Global PasswordManager instance configured with production-grade Argon2id parameters.
 *
 * Tuning Parameters:
 * - `memoryCost`: 131072 KB (128 MB of RAM per hash to defeat GPU/ASIC attacks)
 * - `parallelism`: 8 execution lanes
 * - `iterations`: 2 computational passes
 * - `pepper`: Optional server-side secret injected from `PASSWORD_PEPPER`
 * - `strength`: Minimum 12 characters with built-in dictionary attack prevention
 */
export const pwd = new PasswordManager({
  algorithm: "argon2id",
  memoryCost: 131072, // 128 MB of RAM
  parallelism: 8,    // 8 threads
  iterations: 2,     // 2 passes
  pepper: __sys__.__env__.get("PASSWORD_PEPPER"),
  strength: {
    minLength: 12,
    checkDictionary: true,
  },
});

/**
 * Cryptographic & Password Management Utilities
 *
 * Provides enterprise-grade, OWASP-aligned password hashing and verification
 * powered by `xypriss-security` and the Argon2id memory-hard algorithm.
 *
 * Key Security Features:
 * - **Argon2id Hybrid Algorithm**: Defends against GPU/ASIC brute-force cracking
 *   via enforced memory consumption (64 MB per hash) and resists side-channel attacks.
 * - **Pepper Defense Layer**: Integrates server-level secrets via `PASSWORD_PEPPER`
 *   to mitigate database leak vulnerabilities.
 * - **Constant-Time Verification**: Prevents timing attacks during credential validation.
 *
 * @see https://xypriss.nehonix.com/docs/security/password-manager
 */

import { PasswordManager } from "xypriss-security";

/**
 * Global PasswordManager instance configured with production-grade Argon2id parameters.
 *
 * Tuning Parameters:
 * - `memoryCost`: 65536 KB (64 MB of RAM per hash to defeat GPU/ASIC attacks)
 * - `parallelism`: 4 execution lanes
 * - `iterations`: 3 computational passes
 * - `pepper`: Optional server-side secret injected from `PASSWORD_PEPPER`
 * - `strength`: Minimum 8 characters with built-in dictionary attack prevention
 */
export const pwd = new PasswordManager({
  algorithm: "argon2id",
  memoryCost: 65536, // 64 MB of RAM
  parallelism: 4,    // 4 threads
  iterations: 3,     // 3 passes
  pepper: __sys__.__env__.get("PASSWORD_PEPPER"),
  strength: {
    minLength: 8,
    checkDictionary: true,
  },
});

/**
 * Cryptographic & Password Management Utilities
 *
 * Provides enterprise-grade, OWASP-aligned password hashing and verification
 * powered by `xypriss-security` and the Argon2id memory-hard algorithm.
 *
 * Key Security Features:
 * - **Argon2id Hybrid Algorithm**: Defends against GPU/ASIC brute-force cracking
 *   via enforced memory consumption (32 MB per hash) and resists side-channel attacks.
 * - **Pepper Defense Layer**: Integrates server-level secrets via `PASSWORD_PEPPER`
 *   to mitigate database leak vulnerabilities.
 * - **Constant-Time Verification**: Prevents timing attacks during credential validation.
 *
 * @see https://xypriss.nehonix.com/docs/security/password-manager
 */

import { PasswordManager } from "xypriss-security";

/**
 * Global PasswordManager instance configured with production-grade Argon2id parameters.
 *
 * Tuning Parameters:
 * - `memoryCost`: 32768 KB (32 MB of RAM per hash to defeat GPU/ASIC attacks)
 * - `parallelism`: 8 execution lanes
 * - `iterations`: 2 computational passes
 * - `pepper`: Optional server-side secret injected from `PASSWORD_PEPPER`
 * - `strength`: Minimum 8 characters with built-in dictionary attack prevention
 */
export const pwd = new PasswordManager({
  algorithm: "argon2id",
  memoryCost: 32768, // 32 MB of RAM
  parallelism: 8,    // 8 threads
  iterations: 2,     // 2 passes
  pepper: __sys__.__env__.get("PASSWORD_PEPPER"),
  strength: {
    minLength: 8,
    checkDictionary: true,
  },
});

/**
 * Cryptographic & Password Management Utilities
 *
 * Provides enterprise-grade, OWASP-aligned password hashing and verification
 * powered by `xypriss-security` and the Argon2id memory-hard algorithm.
 *
 * Key Security Features:
 * - **Argon2id Hybrid Algorithm**: Defends against GPU/ASIC brute-force cracking
 *   via enforced memory consumption (32 MB per hash) and resists side-channel attacks.
 * - **Pepper Defense Layer**: Integrates server-level secrets via `PASSWORD_PEPPER`
 *   to mitigate database leak vulnerabilities.
 * - **Constant-Time Verification**: Prevents timing attacks during credential validation.
 *
 * @see https://xypriss.nehonix.com/docs/security/password-manager
 */

import { PasswordManager } from "xypriss-security";

/**
 * Global PasswordManager instance configured with production-grade Argon2id parameters.
 *
 * Tuning Parameters:
 * - `memoryCost`: 32768 KB (32 MB of RAM per hash to defeat GPU/ASIC attacks)
 * - `parallelism`: 8 execution lanes
 * - `iterations`: 3 computational passes
 * - `pepper`: Optional server-side secret injected from `PASSWORD_PEPPER`
 * - `strength`: Minimum 12 characters with built-in dictionary attack prevention
 */
export const pwd = new PasswordManager({
  algorithm: "argon2id",
  memoryCost: 32768, // 32 MB of RAM
  parallelism: 8,    // 8 threads
  iterations: 3,     // 3 passes
  pepper: __sys__.__env__.get("PASSWORD_PEPPER"),
  strength: {
    minLength: 12,
    checkDictionary: true,
  },
});

 * Provides enterprise-grade, OWASP-aligned password hashing and verification
 * powered by `xypriss-security` and the Argon2id memory-hard algorithm.
 *
 * Key Security Features:
 * - **Argon2id Hybrid Algorithm**: Defends against GPU/ASIC brute-force cracking
 *   via enforced memory consumption (64 MB per hash) and resists side-channel attacks.
 * - **Pepper Defense Layer**: Integrates server-level secrets via `PASSWORD_PEPPER`
 *   to mitigate database leak vulnerabilities.
 * - **Constant-Time Verification**: Prevents timing attacks during credential validation.
 *
 * @see https://xypriss.nehonix.com/docs/security/password-manager
 */

import { PasswordManager } from "xypriss-security";

/**
 * Global PasswordManager instance configured with production-grade Argon2id parameters.
 *
 * Tuning Parameters:
 * - `memoryCost`: 65536 KB (64 MB of RAM per hash to defeat GPU/ASIC attacks)
 * - `parallelism`: 2 execution lanes
 * - `iterations`: 4 computational passes
 * - `pepper`: Optional server-side secret injected from `PASSWORD_PEPPER`
 * - `strength`: Minimum 8 characters with built-in dictionary attack prevention
 */
export const pwd = new PasswordManager({
  algorithm: "argon2id",
  memoryCost: 65536, // 64 MB of RAM
  parallelism: 2,    // 2 threads
  iterations: 4,     // 4 passes
  pepper: __sys__.__env__.get("PASSWORD_PEPPER"),
  strength: {
    minLength: 8,
    checkDictionary: true,
  },
});

/**
 * Cryptographic & Password Management Utilities
 *
 * Provides enterprise-grade, OWASP-aligned password hashing and verification
 * powered by `xypriss-security` and the Argon2id memory-hard algorithm.
 *
 * Key Security Features:
 * - **Argon2id Hybrid Algorithm**: Defends against GPU/ASIC brute-force cracking
 *   via enforced memory consumption (32 MB per hash) and resists side-channel attacks.
 * - **Pepper Defense Layer**: Integrates server-level secrets via `PASSWORD_PEPPER`
 *   to mitigate database leak vulnerabilities.
 * - **Constant-Time Verification**: Prevents timing attacks during credential validation.
 *
 * @see https://xypriss.nehonix.com/docs/security/password-manager
 */

import { PasswordManager } from "xypriss-security";

/**
 * Global PasswordManager instance configured with production-grade Argon2id parameters.
 *
 * Tuning Parameters:
 * - `memoryCost`: 32768 KB (32 MB of RAM per hash to defeat GPU/ASIC attacks)
 * - `parallelism`: 2 execution lanes
 * - `iterations`: 2 computational passes
 * - `pepper`: Optional server-side secret injected from `PASSWORD_PEPPER`
 * - `strength`: Minimum 16 characters with built-in dictionary attack prevention
 */
export const pwd = new PasswordManager({
  algorithm: "argon2id",
  memoryCost: 32768, // 32 MB of RAM
  parallelism: 2,    // 2 threads
  iterations: 2,     // 2 passes
  pepper: __sys__.__env__.get("PASSWORD_PEPPER"),
  strength: {
    minLength: 16,
    checkDictionary: true,
  },
});

/**
 * Cryptographic & Password Management Utilities
 *
 * Provides enterprise-grade, OWASP-aligned password hashing and verification
 * powered by `xypriss-security` and the Argon2id memory-hard algorithm.
 *
 * Key Security Features:
 * - **Argon2id Hybrid Algorithm**: Defends against GPU/ASIC brute-force cracking
 *   via enforced memory consumption (32 MB per hash) and resists side-channel attacks.
 * - **Pepper Defense Layer**: Integrates server-level secrets via `PASSWORD_PEPPER`
 *   to mitigate database leak vulnerabilities.
 * - **Constant-Time Verification**: Prevents timing attacks during credential validation.
 *
 * @see https://xypriss.nehonix.com/docs/security/password-manager
 */

import { PasswordManager } from "xypriss-security";

/**
 * Global PasswordManager instance configured with production-grade Argon2id parameters.
 *
 * Tuning Parameters:
 * - `memoryCost`: 32768 KB (32 MB of RAM per hash to defeat GPU/ASIC attacks)
 * - `parallelism`: 8 execution lanes
 * - `iterations`: 4 computational passes
 * - `pepper`: Optional server-side secret injected from `PASSWORD_PEPPER`
 * - `strength`: Minimum 16 characters with built-in dictionary attack prevention
 */
export const pwd = new PasswordManager({
  algorithm: "argon2id",
  memoryCost: 32768, // 32 MB of RAM
  parallelism: 8,    // 8 threads
  iterations: 4,     // 4 passes
  pepper: __sys__.__env__.get("PASSWORD_PEPPER"),
  strength: {
    minLength: 16,
    checkDictionary: true,
  },
});

 * Provides enterprise-grade, OWASP-aligned password hashing and verification
 * powered by `xypriss-security` and the Argon2id memory-hard algorithm.
 *
 * Key Security Features:
 * - **Argon2id Hybrid Algorithm**: Defends against GPU/ASIC brute-force cracking
 *   via enforced memory consumption (32 MB per hash) and resists side-channel attacks.
 * - **Pepper Defense Layer**: Integrates server-level secrets via `PASSWORD_PEPPER`
 *   to mitigate database leak vulnerabilities.
 * - **Constant-Time Verification**: Prevents timing attacks during credential validation.
 *
 * @see https://xypriss.nehonix.com/docs/security/password-manager
 */

import { PasswordManager } from "xypriss-security";

/**
 * Global PasswordManager instance configured with production-grade Argon2id parameters.
 *
 * Tuning Parameters:
 * - `memoryCost`: 32768 KB (32 MB of RAM per hash to defeat GPU/ASIC attacks)
 * - `parallelism`: 2 execution lanes
 * - `iterations`: 2 computational passes
 * - `pepper`: Optional server-side secret injected from `PASSWORD_PEPPER`
 * - `strength`: Minimum 8 characters with built-in dictionary attack prevention
 */
export const pwd = new PasswordManager({
  algorithm: "argon2id",
  memoryCost: 32768, // 32 MB of RAM
  parallelism: 2,    // 2 threads
  iterations: 2,     // 2 passes
  pepper: __sys__.__env__.get("PASSWORD_PEPPER"),
  strength: {
    minLength: 8,
    checkDictionary: true,
  },
});
